## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive (Narrow/Weak). VXX (1W: -4.13% | 1M: -16.05%) BELOW TREND shows fear easing while HYG (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +0.58%) NEUTRAL / LQD (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND signal rising credit stress; SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: -1.22% | 1M: -0.40%) BELOW TREND is mixed confirmation.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Stocks beating bonds: SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND and SPY/TLT rising (↑ rising) supports risk appetite. Fear falling: VXX (1W: -4.13% | 1M: -16.05%) BELOW TREND; offset by credit stress rising via HYG/LQD (HYG (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +0.58%) NEUTRAL; LQD (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND).

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tight: UUP (Dollar proxy) (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +1.21%) ABOVE TREND while TLT (1W: -1.22% | 1M: -0.40%) BELOW TREND and Yield Curve (↓ falling) show slightly tighter conditions.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech and Financials are showing strength but breadth is narrow: XLK (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND, while Energy XLE (1W: +3.49% | 1M: -3.33%) RECOVERY; Style mixed / no clear leadership given 4/11 positive.

**5. US vs Global?**
US leadership evidence: SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND, but EM pockets strong — EEM (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +2.17%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +4.92% | 1M: -2.76%) RECOVERY show selective international upside.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation cooling: IBIT (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +3.10%) ABOVE TREND signals renewed crypto inflows while ARKK (1W: -1.24% | 1M: +6.99%) CORRECTION and IWM (1W: -0.53% | 1M: +4.10%) CORRECTION show boutique/speculative lag and profit-taking.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Agricultural strength and select industrials: WEAT (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +5.99%) ABOVE TREND and DBA (1W: +3.85% | 1M: +5.67%) ABOVE TREND, while GLD (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -3.52%) BELOW TREND is under pressure.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Oil rebound vs gas weakness: BNO (1W: +6.25% | 1M: -16.47%) RECOVERY and XLE (1W: +3.49% | 1M: -3.33%) RECOVERY show crude strength while UNG (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -6.94%) BELOW TREND signals natural gas weakness.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.81% | 1M: +2.61%) ABOVE TREND show broad market participation; DIVERGENCE: XBI (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +21.16%) CORRECTION and ARKK (1W: -1.24% | 1M: +6.99%) CORRECTION highlight short-term profit-taking in higher-beta pockets.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor selective exposure to Financials XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND and thematic pockets like energy XLE (1W: +3.49% | 1M: -3.33%) RECOVERY while reducing exposure to speculative/short-term laggards such as UNG (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -6.94%) BELOW TREND and baskets showing CORRECTION.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Financials XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND and Energy XLE (1W: +3.49% | 1M: -3.33%) RECOVERY if credit spreads stabilize. BEARISH: Materials XME (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -10.63%) BELOW TREND and Utilities XLU (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +3.91%) CORRECTION if risk sentiment derails.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Wheat WEAT (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +5.99%) ABOVE TREND and Brent BNO (1W: +6.25% | 1M: -16.47%) RECOVERY on supply concerns. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -6.94%) BELOW TREND and silver SLV (1W: -1.94% | 1M: -8.57%) BELOW TREND on weak industrial demand.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX (1W: -4.13% | 1M: -16.05%) BELOW TREND — watch ~20 for complacency; HYG (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +0.58%) NEUTRAL / LQD (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND — watch HYG/LQD ratio for credit stress; XLK (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) ABOVE TREND vs XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND — monitor the relative pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, conflicting signals from falling VXX (1W: -4.13% | 1M: -16.05%) BELOW TREND and rising credit stress (HYG (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +0.58%) NEUTRAL / LQD (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND). XLK (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength; key risk is narrow breadth and rising credit strains to monitor.
